summary: End-to-end testing of Soluciones Eléctricas landing. Backend pytest suite (7/7) all passing — health, root, contact create with REAL Resend send (email_status='sent', email_id returned), 422 validation on missing fields/invalid email/short message, GET /api/contact list with no _id leak. Frontend: all 9 testid sections render (hero/trust-banner/about/services/testimonials/contact/final-cta/site-footer/floating-whatsapp), 8 service cards (service-card-0..7), navbar Servicios link scrolls to services-section, hero-cta-call has tel:+541151527707, floating WhatsApp wa.me href correct, mobile-menu-toggle opens nav. Quote form (form-name/email/phone/service/message/submit-btn) submits successfully and shows sonner success toast '¡Consulta enviada! Te respondemos en horario comercial.' then resets fields.

integration_issues.issue: Empty submit triggers browser native HTML5 'required' tooltip instead of sonner error toast. The toast.error('Completá los campos obligatorios.') in onSubmit never fires because native validation blocks submit. Either remove `required` from inputs and rely on JS validation, or accept native validation (current spec asked for a toast).

action_items: Optional: align empty-form UX with spec — remove HTML `required` from inputs in Contact.jsx so React-side toast.error fires for empty fields, OR update spec to accept native browser validation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py persists `email_error` in DB but excludes it from ContactRecord response — fine, but consider logging/alerting when email_status='failed' so notifications aren't silently lost.
Contact.jsx maps SERVICES list independently of backend; backend accepts any string up to 120 chars so harmless, but consider a shared constants source.
Sonner toast container (Toaster) is mounted at top-right with richColors — works correctly.
All required data-testid attributes present on interactive elements.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_ contact records via real POST /api/contact (Resend emails actually sent to lucianaklein17@gmail.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is reusable. Resend integration is live — POST /api/contact will actually email lucianaklein17@gmail.com. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. Form testids are form-name/form-email/form-phone/form-service/form-message/form-submit-btn (NOT quote-name etc as the original spec mentioned). Service select is Shadcn — open with click then click [role=option]. Sonner toasts queryable via [data-sonner-toast].
rca_of_the_issue: Empty-form submission shows browser native validation, not sonner toast: root cause is `required` attribute on Input elements blocking form submit before onSubmit handler runs.
